timeline.sample_positions: z_m is the centre in metres of each of 400 physical axial cells from zzim-geo_corn_mc2nu_pos_deflated.gkyl, checked between both runs.
timeline.density: n[frame] (m^-3), integral of zzim-ion_M0_{frame}.gkyl times zzim-geo_int_jacobgeo.gkyl divided by integral of that Jacobian in each cell. Curves join cell means.
timeline.final: Frame 75 at 0.500150 s. zzim-ion_BiMaxwellianMoments_75.gkyl and zzim-field_75.gkyl. Native DG constant mode divided by sqrt(2); u in m/s, temperatures converted by ion mass over charge and 1000 to keV, phi in V.
timeline.precision: Nine significant figures in 400-cell profiles. All decoded values checked against the source at 5e-9 relative, coordinates at 5e-9 m absolute. Signed samples retained.
timeline.phase_clock: Five 100-ms OAPs each followed by 15 microseconds of FDP. Additional final 75 microseconds of FDP. Zoom frame 45 is the boundary. Step between saved records; each run carries its own header time.

potential.source: zzim-field_{frame}.gkyl interpolated and mapped with zzim-geo_corn_mc2nu_pos_deflated.gkyl, sampled using select(z0=target) as in PRE field.py.
potential.units: volts (V), times_s (s), nu_s_inv (s^-1, final Maxwellian midplane total ion Dougherty frequency), normalized drop (phi_A-phi_B)/940 V.
potential.theory_reference: PRE audit/numbers.json maxwellian.potentials.dougherty and .expander; respectively electron confinement matched to measured ion tau_p, and adiabatic expansion using saved field and flow. Thesis 5.4.1, Fig. 5.5.
potential.verification: All 76 rows and clocks survive JSON losslessly. Both final drops agree with independent PRE audit within 1e-12 absolute.
